description: REPEATABILITY probe — the same scenarios run many times (use --repeat) to quantify non-determinism. Spans the spectrum: a should-always-pass baseline, two known-intermittent cases, a known-hallucination canary, and a should-always-fail. The spread tells us how flaky the agent/browser/LLM stack is.

scenarios.goal: Log in to the application, then confirm you have reached the dashboard. Report the page heading.
Log in, open the edit profile page, change the display name field to 'Zelda Nakamura', and save the form.
Log in, go to /visual/colors. The page shows a status indicator. If the indicator is green, click Approve; if it is red, click Reject.
Log in, go to /widgets/multiselect, select BOTH 'Red' and 'Blue' in the multi-select list, and click Save.
Log in, go to the shadow DOM page at /shadow-dom, and click the first button inside the shadow component on that page.
